# obs_collection_seed (Resource)

Cold bootstrap of a dedicated local absolute-coordinate OBS collection. Apply only with OBS closed, then start OBS and select the collection before applying scene resources. Never converts existing collections. Destroy retains the file and all scenes; it only forgets this binding.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `path` (String)
- `scene_collection_directory` (String)

### Read-Only

- `bootstrap_scene_uuid` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `seed_sha256` (String)
